how_to_use: Run each prompt with the skill installed. A pass needs every expected behaviour. Use these to compare changes to the skill before merging.

cases.prompt: Help me put a dragon into a drone shot I filmed.
expect: Runs the setup interview in rounds of up to 4 questions with options
Asks for camera model and picture profile
Saves answers to vfx-profile.md
Does not start building before the brief is approved

cases.prompt: New shot: a car explodes behind me in a parking lot.
expect: Does not re-ask camera or computer questions
Runs the shot interview
Picks a composite strategy and says why
Suggests stock elements for the main blast
States estimate, frames, settings and output path
Shows or offers a contact sheet first
Waits for approval before rendering

cases.prompt: This 4 second render will take 90 minutes. Make it faster without losing quality.
cases.context: Scene open in Blender via MCP.
expect: Runs render_doctor.py read-only first
Lists findings with quality risk
Asks before changing settings
Proposes a before and after test on one frame

cases.prompt: What objects are in my scene and is anything slowing it down?
expect: Uses probe_scene.py or render_doctor.py, not a full object dump
Answers in under 15 lines

cases.prompt: I shoot S-Log3 on an 8-bit camera and raise saturation in the profile. Good for VFX?
expect: Advises default saturation and colour phase in the log profile
Advises exposing 1 to 2 stops over on 8-bit
Mentions the colour round trip test

cases.prompt: Simulate a tsunami flooding a city on my laptop.
cases.context: Profile says 16 GB laptop with a 4 GB GPU.
expect: Says plainly the full sim is beyond the hardware
Offers a stock or 2.5D alternative
Does not start a huge bake

cases.prompt: Build the scene, render a test and composite it.
expect: Writes no files to the project root except README.md
Edits scripts in scripts/ instead of creating _v2 copies
Puts debug frames in _review/ and temp files in _tmp/
Clears _tmp/ and reports new files at the end

cases.prompt: Remove the bin behind me in this clip.
cases.context: Profile says Blender experience: new. Learning off.
expect: Uses Filmmaker mode wording, no unexplained terms like solve error or Cryptomatte
Gives one recommended plan in two or three sentences
Does not add a lesson or explanation nobody asked for
Still stops at the approval gate before rendering

cases.prompt: Teach me why you tracked it that way, briefly.
expect: Answers in two or three sentences
Goes back to the work after answering
Does not turn learning on for the rest of the session

cases.prompt: Find me a realistic dragon model.
expect: Suggests only free or CC0 sources
Does not suggest paid marketplaces or paid AI 3D services
Asks before downloading

cases.context: 05_blend/sh020/state/ exists with stage render and a recorded footage analysis.
expect: Runs vfx.py status instead of re-probing the whole project
Does not re-run vfx.py analyse when state check says the result is unchanged
Does not read history.jsonl in full

cases.prompt: Remove the cup from the table. Camera is on a tripod and nothing moves.
expect: Chooses a static patch, not a camera solve or AI mask
Explains the choice in one line

cases.prompt: Put a rusty barrel next to the door in my shot.
expect: Runs one vfx.py assets search with --sheet
Shows 3 to 5 options with link, licence, resolution, polygons and suitability
Does not download before the user picks
Offers procedural_asset.py if nothing fits

cases.prompt: Track this and put a robot on the floor.
cases.context: vfx.py analyse returns motion unknown (few features).
expect: Says the move could not be determined and why
Does not pick a solve type silently
Offers manual markers, a test full solve, or a reshoot

cases.prompt: Make a fist-sized hole blow out of the wall behind me.
expect: Builds a proxy wall from tracked points with build_proxy.py and checks rms_mm
Fractures only around the impact with destruction.py
Asks before a long bake

cases.prompt: The render stopped when my laptop slept. Finish it.
cases.context: A job manifest exists with status running and no live process.
expect: Runs vfx.py job or status and reports the job as interrupted
Resumes only the missing or corrupt frames
Does not restart the whole range
